D. 要去北京

题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：Lucy is excited ______ her birthday party.
A. about
B. at
C. with
D. on
考点：用法
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："The kids are over-excited" means they are ______.
A. too excited and noisy
B. not excited at all
C. very tired
D. very quiet
考点：易混
题目.答案:
【1】D（要去北京）
讲解：excited because I'm going to Beijing。
【2】C（excited）
讲解：说人的感受用 excited。
【3】exciting
讲解：说事情（旅行）令人兴奋用 exciting。
【4】more excited
讲解：than 前面用比较级 more excited。
【5】exciting → excited
讲解：说人的感受用 excited。
【6】A（about）
讲解：be excited about 对……感到兴奋。
【7】A（too excited and noisy）
讲解：over-excited 是过于兴奋、闹过头。
